content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Associate Professor: A medical qualification included in the I or II schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956; A postgraduate qualification e.g. MD/MS or equivalent; For Super specialty: D.M./M.Ch. in respective discipline. Experience: Six years teaching and/or research experience in recognized Institution in the subject of specialty after obtaining the qualifying degree.

content_sections.text: Professor/Additional Professor: Maximum 58 years. Associate/Assistant Professor: Maximum 50 years. Age Relaxation: PwBD: 10 years, SC/ST: 5 years, OBC: 3 years, Government servants: 5 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-11-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Mangalagiri to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty recruitment is 02 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Associate Professor?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the post of Associate Professor, specifically in General Surgery and Neurosurgery departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for UR/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for UR/EWS/OBC category candidates is Rs. 3100 as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there an age relaxation for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are eligible for an age relaxation of 5 years over the maximum age limit prescribed for the respective posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of document verification followed by an interview conducted by the Standing Selection Committee at AIIMS Mangalagiri.

faq.question: Q6. Can I send the hard copy of the application after the deadline?
faq.answer: No, all applications, including the hard copy sent via speed post or courier, must reach the institute on or before the closing date of 02 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a medical qualification (MBBS) along with a postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DM/MCh) in the relevant discipline to be eligible for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. Is the application process entirely online?
faq.answer: While the initial application is online, candidates are also required to send a hard copy of their application along with self-attested documents via speed post/courier.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for an Associate Professor at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: The Associate Professor post falls under Level 13-A1+ of the Pay Matrix, with a minimum pay of Rs. 1,38,300/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification is available on the official website of AIIMS Mangalagiri at www.aiimsmangalagiri.edu.in under the recruitment section.
